description: A high-level, high-performance dynamic programming language for technical computing

option.name: --banner
tip: Enable or disable the startup banner.
Possible values: auto, no, short, yes
Default: auto

option.name: --bug-report=
tip: Launch a bug report session.
It can start a REPL, run a script, or evaluate expressions.
It first tries BugReporting.jl from the current environment, then falls back to the latest compatible BugReporting.jl.

option.name: --check-bounds
tip: Emit bounds checks always, never, or respect @inbounds declarations.
Possible values: auto, no, yes
Default: auto

option.name: --code-coverage
tip: Count executions of source lines.
Omitting the value is equivalent to user.
Use @ before a path to count only files under that path; @ alone tracks the current directory.
tracefile.info appends coverage information to the LCOV tracefile.
Possible values: @, all, none, tracefile.info, user
Default: none
The value must be attached with =.
Track only files under the current directory.

next.name: tracefile.info
tip: Append coverage data to the LCOV tracefile.

option.name: --color
tip: Enable or disable color text.
Possible values: auto, no, yes
Default: auto

option.name: --compile
tip: Enable or disable the JIT compiler, or request exhaustive or minimal compilation.
Possible values: all, min, no, yes
Default: yes

option.name: --compiled-modules
tip: Enable or disable incremental precompilation of modules.
The existing option allows use of existing compiled modules that were previously precompiled, but disallows creation of new precompile files.
The strict option is similar, but will error if no precompile file is found.
Possible values: existing, no, strict, yes
Default: yes

option.name: --compress-sysimage
tip: Compress the sys/pkgimage heap at the expense of slightly increased load time.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: no

option.name: --cpu-target
tip: Limit usage of CPU features up to <target>.
Set to help to see the available options.
Default: native

next.name: help
tip: List the available CPU targets.

next.name: native
tip: Use the host CPU's native features.

option.name: --debug-info
tip: Set the level of debug info generation.
Level 2 is used when -g is given without a level.
Possible values: 0, 1, 2
Default: 1
The long form requires the value attached with =.

option.name: --depwarn
tip: Enable or disable syntax and method deprecation warnings.
error turns warnings into errors.
Possible values: error, no, yes
Default: no

option.name: --eval
tip: Evaluate <expr>.

option.name: --experimental
tip: Enable the use of experimental (alpha) features.

option.name: --gc-sweep-always-full
tip: Make the GC always do a full sweep of the heap.

option.name: --gcthreads
tip: Use N threads for the mark phase of GC and M (0 or 1) threads for the concurrent sweeping phase.
N defaults to the number of compute threads and M defaults to 0.

option.name: --handle-signals
tip: Enable or disable Julia's default signal handlers.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: yes

option.name: --hard-heap-limit
tip: Set a hard limit on the heap size; the process aborts if it goes above this limit.
The value may be specified as a number of bytes, optionally in units of B, K, M, G, or T.

option.name: --heap-size-hint
tip: Force garbage collection if memory usage is higher than the given value.
The value may be specified as a number of bytes, optionally in units of B, K, M, G, T, or % (percentage of physical memory).

option.name: --heap-target-increment
tip: Set an upper bound on how much the heap target can increase between consecutive collections.
The value may be specified as a number of bytes, optionally in units of B, K, M, G, or T.

option.name: --help
tip: Print command-line options (this message).

option.name: --help-hidden
tip: Print uncommon options not shown by -h.

option.name: --history-file
tip: Load or save history.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: yes

option.name: --home
tip: Set the location of the julia executable.

option.name: --image-codegen
tip: Force code generation in imaging mode.

option.name: --inline
tip: Control whether inlining is permitted, including overriding @inline declarations.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: yes

option.name: --interactive
tip: Interactive mode; the REPL runs and isinteractive() is true.

option.name: --load
tip: Load <file> immediately on all processors.

option.name: --machine-file
tip: Run processes on hosts listed in <file>.

option.name: --math-mode
tip: Always follow ieee floating point semantics or respect @fastmath declarations.
Possible values: ieee, user
Default: user

option.name: --min-optlevel=
tip: Set a lower bound on the optimization level.
Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 3
Default: 0

option.name: --module
tip: Run the entry point of Package (its @main function) with args.

option.name: --optimize
tip: Set the optimization level.
Level 3 is used when -O is given without a level.
Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 3
Default: 2
The long form requires the value attached with =.

option.name: --output-asm
tip: Generate an assembly file (.s).

option.name: --output-bc
tip: Generate LLVM bitcode (.bc).

option.name: --output-incremental
tip: Generate an incremental output file (rather than a complete one).
Possible values: no, yes
Default: no

option.name: --output-ji
tip: Generate a system image data file (.ji).

option.name: --output-o
tip: Generate an object file (including system image data).

option.name: --output-unopt-bc
tip: Generate unoptimized LLVM bitcode (.bc).

option.name: --permalloc-pkgimg
tip: Copy the data section of package images into memory.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: no

option.name: --pkgimages
tip: Enable or disable usage of native code caching in the form of pkgimages.
The existing option allows use of existing pkgimages but disallows creation of new ones.
Possible values: existing, no, yes
Default: yes

option.name: --print
tip: Evaluate <expr> and display the result.

option.name: --procs
tip: Integer N launches N additional local worker processes.
auto launches as many workers as the number of local CPU threads (logical cores).

next.name: auto
tip: Launch as many workers as local CPU threads.

option.name: --project
tip: Set <dir> as the active project/environment.
Or, create a temporary environment with @temp.
The default @. option searches parent directories until a Project.toml or JuliaProject.toml file is found.
@script is similar, but searches up from the programfile or a path relative to it.
The value must be attached with =.
Search parent directories for a project file.

next.name: @script
tip: Search upward from the program file.

next.name: @temp
tip: Create a temporary environment.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Quiet startup: no banner, suppress REPL warnings.

option.name: --startup-file
tip: Load JULIA_DEPOT_PATH/config/startup.jl; if JULIA_DEPOT_PATH is unset, load ~/.julia/config/startup.jl.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: yes

option.name: --strip-ir
tip: Remove the IR (intermediate representation) of compiled functions.

option.name: --strip-metadata
tip: Remove docstrings and source location info from the system image.

option.name: --sysimage
tip: Start up with the given system image file.

option.name: --sysimage-native-code
tip: Use native code from the system image if available.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: yes

option.name: --task-metrics
tip: Enable collection of per-task timing data.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: no

option.name: --threads
tip: Enable N[+M] threads; N threads are assigned to the default threadpool, and if M is specified, M threads are assigned to the interactive threadpool.
auto tries to infer a useful default number of threads; currently it sets N to the number of CPUs assigned to this process (or the number of CPU threads if affinity is not configured) and M to 1.

next.name: auto
tip: Infer a default thread count.

option.name: --timeout-for-safepoint-straggler
tip: If this value is set, dump the backtrace for a thread that fails to reach a safepoint within the specified time.

option.name: --trace-compile
tip: Print precompile statements for methods compiled during execution, or save them to stderr or a path.
Methods that were recompiled are printed in yellow or with a trailing comment if color is not supported.

next.name: stderr
tip: Print precompile statements to stderr.

option.name: --trace-compile-timing
tip: Show how long each compilation took in ms when --trace-compile is enabled.

option.name: --trace-eval=
tip: Show the expression being evaluated before eval.
Possible values: full, loc, no
Default: no

option.name: --track-allocation
tip: Count bytes allocated by each source line.
Omitting the value is equivalent to user.
Use @ before a path to count only files under that path; @ alone tracks the current directory.
Possible values: @, all, none, user
Default: none
The value must be attached with =.
Track only files under the current directory.

option.name: --trim
tip: Build a sysimage including only code provably reachable from methods marked by calling entrypoint.
In unsafe mode, the resulting binary might be missing needed code and can throw errors.
With unsafe-warn, warnings are printed for dynamic call sites that might lead to such errors.
In safe mode, compile-time errors are given instead.
Requires --experimental.
Possible values: no, safe, unsafe, unsafe-warn
Default: no

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

option.name: --warn-overwrite
tip: Enable or disable method overwrite warnings.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: yes

option.name: --warn-scope
tip: Enable or disable the warning for ambiguous top-level scope.
Possible values: no, yes
Default: yes
